points.description: Identifies ONE reasonable character trait for Rose based on her conversations with Anna or Aunt Kolab (e.g., responsible, caring/compassionate, hardworking, dutiful, considerate, protective, mature, honest, self-sacrificing, thoughtful of others' feelings). Equivalent wording accepted.

Gives ONE accurate detail from the story (from the conversations with Anna or Aunt Kolab, or closely tied to them) that supports the trait named, e.g., she gently reminds Anna that Papa had to go and that they must help Paul finish college; she doesn't tell her aunt the truth to avoid hurting her; she nods to accept her aunt's offer. The detail must logically match the trait. Paraphrase or quotation accepted.

rubric.notes: Full marks: a valid trait plus one accurate, matching story detail. 1 mark if only the trait is valid, or the detail is accurate but doesn't match the trait (award the detail mark only if a trait is implied). No marks for an inaccurate trait and unsupported detail.
